raw.description: Accept browser dialog. Provide promptText for prompts.
raw.name: accept_dialog

raw.description: Clear collected console messages.
raw.name: clear_console_messages

raw.description: Clear the tracked downloads buffer.
raw.name: clear_downloads

raw.description: Clear snapshot UIDs. Usually not needed.
raw.name: clear_snapshot

raw.description: Click element by UID. Set dblClick for double-click.
raw.name: click_by_uid

raw.description: Ends the browser session. If the server connected to your existing Firefox, this releases the connection and leaves Firefox running. If the server started Firefox itself, this closes it. Call this when the browser task is complete and no further browser interaction is expected.
raw.name: close_firefox_session

raw.description: Close tab by index.
raw.name: close_page

raw.description: Dismiss browser dialog.
raw.name: dismiss_dialog

raw.description: Drag element to another (HTML5 drag events).
raw.name: drag_by_uid_to_uid

raw.description: Enable the JS debugger for the current page. Required before set_logpoint works. Requires Firefox 153+.
raw.name: enable_debugger

raw.description: Run a JS function in the page and return its result. Prefer this for targeted reads (a value, text, computed style, whether an element exists) instead of a full take_snapshot. Use the UID interaction tools for clicking, typing, and filling.

args.description: UIDs to pass as function arguments

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved result to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

sandbox.description: Evaluate in an isolated sandbox realm with this name instead of the page realm. The sandbox shares the page DOM and keeps the native built-ins even where the page overrode them. Page-defined globals and expandos are invisible from the sandbox, and vice-versa. The same name reuses the same sandbox across calls; omit to evaluate in the page realm.

saveTo.description: Save the result to a file as JSON instead of returning it inline. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

raw.name: evaluate_script

raw.description: Fill text input/textarea by UID.
raw.name: fill_by_uid

raw.description: Fill multiple form fields at once.
raw.name: fill_form_by_uid

raw.description: Get information about the current Firefox instance configuration, including binary path, environment variables, and output file location.
raw.name: get_firefox_info

raw.description: Retrieve Firefox output (stdout/stderr including MOZ_LOG, warnings, crashes, stack traces). Returns recent output from the capture file. Use filters to focus on specific content.

grep.description: Filter log lines containing this string (case-insensitive)

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to return (default: 100, max: 10000)

since.description: Only show logs written in the last N seconds

raw.name: get_firefox_output

raw.description: Get the results collected by a logpoint since it was set.
raw.name: get_logpoint_results

raw.description: Get request details by ID, including the response body (and request body when present). Large text bodies are truncated inline; binary bodies are summarized. URL lookup as fallback.

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved output to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save the request details with full untruncated headers and bodies to a file as JSON instead of returning them inline (binary bodies are stored base64-encoded). Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

raw.name: get_network_request

raw.description: Get the visible text of the page (document.body.innerText). Caps at maxLength (default 20000 chars); saveTo saves the full text to a file.

maxLength.description: Max characters to return inline (default: 20000). Ignored when saveTo is used.

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved text to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save the full untruncated text to a file instead of returning it inline. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

raw.name: get_page_text

raw.description: Get the source code of a JavaScript file loaded in the page. Requires enable_debugger to have been called.

scriptUrl.description: URL of the script to retrieve.

raw.name: get_script_source

raw.description: Hover over element by UID.
raw.name: hover_by_uid

raw.description: Install a Firefox extension using WebDriver BiDi webExtension.install command. Supports installing from archive (.xpi/.zip), base64-encoded data, or unpacked directory.

path.description: File path (for archivePath or path types)

permanent.description: Firefox-specific: Install permanently (requires signed extension). Default: false (temporary install)

type.description: Extension data type: "archivePath" for .xpi/.zip, "base64" for encoded data, "path" for unpacked directory

raw.name: install_extension

raw.description: List console messages, filterable by level, time, text, source. Caps at limit (default 50); saveTo saves all matches to a file.

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved output to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save matching messages to a file in full (untruncated) instead of returning them inline. Saves all matching messages by default; pass an explicit limit to cap how many are saved. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

raw.name: list_console_messages

raw.description: List downloads tracked since startup, including status and saved file path.
raw.name: list_downloads

raw.description: List network requests, returning IDs for get_network_request. Filter by url/method/status; caps at limit (default 50); saveTo saves all matches to a file.

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved output to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save matching requests to a file as JSON instead of returning them inline. Saves full untruncated headers by default; pass detail=summary or min for a lean form, or an explicit limit to cap how many are saved (default: all matching). Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

raw.name: list_network_requests

raw.description: List open tabs (index, title, URL). Selected tab is marked.
raw.name: list_pages

raw.description: List all JavaScript files currently loaded in the page. Requires enable_debugger to have been called.
raw.name: list_scripts

raw.description: Navigate history back/forward. UIDs become stale.
raw.name: navigate_history

raw.description: Navigate selected tab to URL.

wait.description: When to return: 'none' (navigation started), 'interactive' (DOMContentLoaded), 'complete' (load event fired, including subresources). Omit for the default: 'interactive' for http/https/data/blob/file, 'none' for other schemes. Use 'complete' when the page must be fully loaded, e.g. before stopping a performance recording.

raw.name: navigate_page

raw.description: Open new tab at URL. Returns tab index.

wait.description: When to return: 'none' (navigation started), 'interactive' (DOMContentLoaded), 'complete' (load event fired, including subresources). Omit for the default: 'interactive' for http/https/data/blob/file, 'none' for other schemes. Use 'complete' when the page must be fully loaded, e.g. before stopping a performance recording.

raw.name: new_page

raw.description: Press a single key, optionally with modifiers, to submit, dismiss, navigate or trigger a shortcut. Not for entering text: use fill_by_uid instead.

key.description: One key, optionally preceded by "+"-separated modifiers, such as "Escape", "Enter" or "ctrl+shift+t". Modifiers: ctrl, alt, shift, meta. Named keys: Enter, Return, NumpadEnter, Tab, Backspace, Delete, Insert, Space, Escape, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, F1-F12, Numpad0-Numpad9, Clear, Pause, Help, Cancel, Semicolon, Equals, Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, Decimal, Separator. Anything else must be a single character. Any number of modifiers, but only one key.

uid.description: Focusable element UID from snapshot to focus before pressing (default: the already focused element)

raw.name: press_key

raw.description: Check whether the Firefox profiler is currently recording.
raw.name: profiler_is_active

raw.description: Start the Firefox profiler. Provide either a preset name or explicit recording options (entries, interval, features, threads). Cannot combine both. Valid presets: web-developer, firefox-platform, graphics, media, ml, networking, power, debug.

activeContext.description: Id of the top-level navigable to mark as the active tab in the profile. Does not restrict profiling to that tab.

entries.description: Number of entries to keep in the sampling buffer. Required when no preset is given.

features.description: Profiler features to enable. Required when no preset is given.

interval.description: Sampling interval in milliseconds. Required when no preset is given.

preset.description: Profiler preset name. Cannot be combined with entries, interval, features, or threads.

threads.description: Thread names to profile. Required when no preset is given.

raw.name: profiler_start

raw.description: Stop the Firefox profiler and save the recorded profile to a file in the downloads directory. Returns the path to the saved file, or null when nothing was saved.

discard.description: If true, stop the profiler and discard the recording instead of saving it to disk. Defaults to false.

raw.name: profiler_stop

raw.description: Remove a previously set logpoint.
raw.name: remove_logpoint

raw.description: Resolve UID to CSS selector. Fails if the element is gone.
raw.name: resolve_uid_to_selector

raw.description: Start recording a screencast (video) of the current page viewport, saving the output to a file in the downloads directory. Returns a screencast id to pass to screencast_stop. Multiple recordings can run at once.

context.description: Id of the top-level browsing context to record. Defaults to the currently selected page.

frameRate.description: Target frame rate of the recording, in frames per second.

height.description: Height of the recorded video in pixels. Defaults to the viewport height.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the output file. Defaults to "video/webm".

width.description: Width of the recorded video in pixels. Defaults to the viewport width.

raw.name: screencast_start

raw.description: Stop an in-progress screencast recording started with screencast_start and finalize the video file. Returns the path to the saved file.

screencast.description: Id of the screencast to stop, as returned by screencast_start. Optional when exactly one recording is active.

raw.name: screencast_stop

raw.description: Capture element screenshot by UID as base64 PNG.

saveTo.description: Save the screenshot to a file instead of returning it as image data in the response. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

raw.name: screenshot_by_uid

raw.description: Capture viewport screenshot as base64 PNG. Set fullPage for the whole scrollable document.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable document (default: false)

saveTo.description: Save the screenshot to a file instead of returning it as image data in the response. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

raw.name: screenshot_page

raw.description: Select active tab by index, URL, or title. Index takes precedence.
raw.name: select_page

raw.description: Control how downloads are handled: allow (save to a destination folder), deny (cancel), or reset to default. Avoids the native save-file dialog. Requires a recent Firefox.

behavior.description: 'allowed' saves downloads to `downloadFolder`, 'denied' cancels them, 'default' resets to the browser default

downloadFolder.description: Path to the folder where downloads should be stored, created if missing. Only used for behavior='allowed', where it defaults to ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/downloads. Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

raw.name: set_download_behavior

raw.description: Set a logpoint at a specific location. When execution reaches that line, the expression is evaluated and the result is stored without pausing. Use get_logpoint_results to retrieve collected values. Requires enable_debugger to have been called.

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate each time the logpoint is hit.

raw.name: set_logpoint

raw.description: Control the HTTP cache. Use behavior='bypass' so every request goes to the network — useful for performance measurement and for verifying a change that a cached asset would otherwise hide. Applies to the currently selected tab unless scope='global'. Persists until set back to 'default' or Firefox shuts down.

behavior.description: 'bypass' to skip the cache, 'default' to restore normal caching

scope.description: 'tab' (default) applies to the selected tab; 'global' applies browser-wide

raw.name: set_network_cache

raw.description: Set viewport dimensions in pixels.
raw.name: set_viewport_size

raw.description: Capture DOM snapshot with stable UIDs. A UID stays valid across snapshots until its element is removed or the page navigates. Output caps at maxLines (default 100); scope with selector or dump the full tree with saveTo.

includeAll.description: Include all visible elements without relevance filtering. Useful for Vue/Livewire apps (default: false)

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved output to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save the complete snapshot text to a file (ignores maxLines) instead of returning it inline. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope snapshot to specific element (e.g., "#app")

raw.name: take_snapshot

raw.description: Type text key by key into the focused element, optionally followed by a key such as Enter. Use fill_by_uid to set the value of a known input; use this for elements that only react to real typing, such as autocomplete fields and rich text editors.

submitKey.description: Key to press after the text, such as "Enter" or "Tab". Same syntax as press_key.

uid.description: Focusable element UID from snapshot to focus before typing (default: the already focused element)

raw.name: type_text

raw.description: Uninstall a Firefox extension using WebDriver BiDi webExtension.uninstall command. Requires the extension ID returned by install_extension or obtained from list_extensions.
raw.name: uninstall_extension

raw.description: Upload file to file input by UID.
raw.name: upload_file_by_uid
